scientific_integrity: Analytical proof of all dimensions and equality cases; independent validation not performed.
scientific_limitations: Not a quantitative inequality for all nonlinear harmonic maps; unrestricted zonal profiles, translations, and non-nuclear distances not classified. Motivating source full text not accessible; potential equivalent prior result remains a risk.
scientific_scope: Real homogeneous affine componentwise harmonic self-maps of the Euclidean unit ball; sharp normalized mean-width deficit with nuclear distance to O(n).
title: Sharp nuclear-distance mean-width stability for affine harmonic ball maps
